name: miltank-vs-prior
question: Does MILTANK v1 (lean playouts, full clock) earn a higher per-series ladder residual than DODUO-greedy (prior) on the same account, rotation and opponent pool?

A.note: MILTANK v1 on the full clock budget (clock.js); CHOMP-lite preview

B.note: MAG v1 + DODUO v1 greedy; the rotation team's own human bring at preview

assignment: per series, sha256(seed|k|arm) mod 2 over the sorted arm ids (solver/rotom/ladder.js assign); committed before the first game
metric: per-series residual r = S - E, E = 1/(1+10^((R_opp - R_me)/400)) from the server's pre-series ratings; ties S = 0.5
burn_in: series played while the account's pre-series rating is below 1300 are burn-in and are not read (docs/_reports/2026-09-23-solver-research-humans-and-ladder.md §3.1, §3.4 step 2)

sprt.statistic: mean(r | A) - mean(r | B), normal approximation, sigma_r = 0.5 per series
sprt.read: once, at a bound; never an interim read
sprt.expected_scale: about 770 series per arm for +50 Elo (…humans-and-ladder.md §3.3)

headline: mean rating over the last N >= 100 series +- SD, per arm and overall. Never the peak.
